Our Portfolio Companies.
Discover the Builders.

We back leaders leveraging cutting-edge technology to rethink industries and uplift the communities they serve.

AMI Labs
C.2025 SEED

Building a new class of AI systems with persistent memory, real-world understanding, and controllability by design. Chaired by Turing Award laureate Yann LeCun, led by serial AI entrepreneur Alexandre LeBrun.

Read more
MOONSHOT AI (KIMI)
C.2026 SERIES D

China's leading long-context AI lab, built to reason across massive inputs where others fall short. Its open-source Kimi models have set new benchmarks in agentic tasks, coding, and multimodal reasoning.

Read more
Nabla
C.2024 SERIES B

The most advanced AI assistant in clinical care. Nabla listens to clinical encounters and writes the notes — freeing clinicians to focus on patients. Now evolving into a full agentic platform.

Read more
Bioptimus
C.2024 SEED

Building the first universal AI foundation model for biology — integrating data from molecules to whole organisms. Founded by scientists from Google DeepMind and Owkin, already reshaping pharma research.

Read more
Logical Intelligence
C.2025 SEED

AI that doesn't guess. Its Kona model uses energy-based reasoning to deliver mathematically verified outputs for critical systems where hallucinations are unacceptable. Chaired by Yann LeCun.

Read more
Galaxea
C.2025 SERIES A

Full-stack humanoid robotics combining advanced AI with hardware built for real deployment. Founded by Tsinghua and Stanford scientists, its robots are already working alongside global automakers and logistics companies.

Read more
Palmpay
C.2021 SERIES A

The on-ramp to financial opportunity for millions across Africa and Asia — from first-time device financing to full digital banking and merchant services, built for those traditional finance left behind.

Read more
Momenta
C.2017 SERIES B HKG: 6880

Building the AI brain for autonomous vehicles — from advanced driver assistance to full self-driving. Its data flywheel approach and global automaker partnerships are making intelligent driving a reality.

Read more
Chime
C.2017 SERIES B NASDAQ: CHYM

America's #1 choice for banking — built to make core financial services helpful, easy, and free for everyday people. Where traditional banks charge fees and set barriers, Chime removes them. Now public and expanding into credit, paycheck advances, and workplace financial wellness.

Read more
Glovo
C.2017 SERIES B ACQUIRED

Europe's leading on-demand delivery platform connecting millions of users with restaurants, grocers, and local businesses. Now part of Delivery Hero, operating across 25+ countries.

Read more
Ledger
C.2018 SERIES B

The world leader in crypto security. Ledger's hardware signers are the gold standard for protecting digital assets — trusted by millions of individuals and institutions. Now expanding into enterprise infrastructure.

Read more
Pinduoduo
C.2017 SERIES B NASDAQ: PDD

Pioneer of social commerce in China, serving hundreds of millions of consumers. Parent company PDD Holdings has since taken the model global through Temu, now one of the world's most downloaded shopping apps.

Read more

The New VC Playbook.
Startups X Industry.

Technology can transform the world, but no one can do it alone. We’ve written a new VC playbook at the intersection of startups and industry.

GLOBAL. COLLABORATIVE. ECOSYSTEM-DRIVEN. PURPOSE-BUILT.

We don’t just write checks. We’re an active partner to founders, helping them turn bold ideas into real-world solutions.

WHO WE ARE
Cathay Innovation is a global, multi-stage venture capital firm and transformation platform, bridging technology and the real economy. Founded in Paris in 2015 as part of the Cathay Capital family, we were born from a vision to connect continents, people and ideas to build transformative businesses everywhere.

Today, we manage over €2.5B in assets and invest across Europe, North America, Asia, Latin America and Africa. Backed by leading Fortune 500 corporations, we've built the world's largest VC platform for startup–corporate collaboration — helping visionary founders scale faster, enter new markets and reshape industries from the inside out.

Cathay Capital Group is a global investment platform founded in 2007, spanning venture, growth and private equity. With €6B+ in AUM across 27 funds, 320+ investments and 86+ exits, we're committed to supporting companies at all stages—from founders to established market leaders.

MINGPO’S STORY
DENIS’ STORY

Mingpo Cai’s journey started at age 20 when he arrived in France with no capital, no network and not a word of French. Today, he’s the founder of Cathay Capital and an influential figure in Sino-French economic relations.

It’s through pure determination and believing that sincerity is the universal language, that Mingpo made his way from China to France, taught himself the language and worked his way through business school.

Mingpo started his first company Stonest to transform the archaic gravestone industry and learned life-long lessons around the value of trust and simply doing what you say. He developed relationships early in his academic years, leading him to open a representative office in Shanghai for France’s Groupe SEB, now an active investor in Cathay Capital.

When he met tenured French private equity investor Edouard Moinet, they bonded immediately over the idea of bridging economic cultures. The two started Cathay Capital and built a global investment platform, with an impressive ecosystem of corporate LPs, to share knowledge and local expertise to help companies go beyond their borders.

It’s when Mingpo moved to New York that he met Denis Barrier, the French venture capitalist living in Silicon Valley who shared the same vision in a global ecosystem that would be useful to entrepreneurs and corporate executives alike. Together, they infused venture into Cathay Capital to push forward digital transformation and scale technologies that will have a positive impact on the world.

Profile
HOW WE INVEST
Our Investment Philosophy

We back founders building with AI and advanced technologies to redefine how industries work — from health and finance to consumer, energy, mobility and beyond.

We partner locally, invest globally, and embed startups in our corporate ecosystem to drive growth through transformative collaboration.

Like the world’s Blue Zones — where people thrive thanks to their environment — we create the conditions where innovation with impact grows by default.

Learn more
Our Sustainability Approach

We back founders reshaping the real economy while creating long-term value — not just for shareholders, but for people and the planet.

Our model integrates ESG and impact from day one, combining patient capital with a global ecosystem to help companies grow fast and thoughtfully.

Learn more

THE PRINCIPLES POWERING THE PLATFORM
1
Be Useful. Always.

Our founding principle — we earn trust by being useful: showing up, following through and creating value in every interaction.

2
One Global Team.
Many Perspectives.

We are one global team from various backgrounds and cultures. The more diversity in perspectives and knowledge, the better outcomes for all.

3
We Do What We Say.

We believe in clarity, honesty, and consistency. We give it straight, keep our word, and stand by our partners at every stage.

4
For the Bold Builders.

We partner with founders who possess purpose, drive, and the fiery determination to create a meaningful legacy.

5
Partners, All In.

Startup life isn’t easy. We show up in the tough moments, not just the headlines — because real partnership means staying in it.

6
Build What Matters.

We back those who build with intention. Tech can — and should — be a force for progress. We help scale solutions that improve life.
